blocks.text: For more than 40 years, the Palawan Group of Companies has grown alongside millions of Filipinos who rely on its services to send money to loved ones, secure their valuables, and access financial solutions. As the company continues to expand its reach, one commitment remains at the heart of its operations: making sure every Suki receives fair, respectful, and reliable service.
